help.title: About inventory
help.overview: How much of each product you have in each warehouse. On hand is what's on the shelf, Reserved is held for orders not shipped yet, and Available is what you can still sell.

sections.title: Adding and changing stock
items: Create inventory to start stocking a product in a warehouse, with its opening quantity. After that, stock changes only through actions, not by editing.
Restock adds goods you received, with the supplier, receipt, cost, batch and expiry if you have them.
Deduct / write-off takes out damaged, lost or corrected goods. You can't deduct below what is reserved.
View movements shows every change, with its reason and who made it.

sections.title: Good to know
items: Products with Track inventory on sell only from available stock in active warehouses. Digital products, services and gift cards need no stock; a bundle uses its parts' stock.
Checkout takes stock from the default warehouse first.
When Available drops below the reorder point, your team is told once.
A row that still has stock or reservations can't be deleted.
